label: Planner
description: Planner on Bryntum Scheduler + Calendar: the conference day as rooms × time (Scheduler; the default for a multi-track day, picks are the agenda's stars, clashes banded), the day by room as a printed programme (Calendar), a trip view, and a calendar of tracked events. Bundle is lazy-loaded on first open. Disable by swapping 'bryntum' for 'module-2' in modules.config.json; delete this directory to remove it entirely.
